title: Internal: CLI Payment History and Approval Criteria
summary: This document defines CLI payment history requirements and maximum credit limit increase amounts by card tier. Entry-tier requires 6 consecutive on-time months and allows up to 25% increase per request; Mid- and Premium-tier require 3 consecutive months and allow up to 50% per request.
